projects.title: Contact Center KPI & Performance Project
projects.summary: This project simulates a real-world energy company contact center, where we build an interactive KPI dashboard to track operational performance, efficiency, customer service, and key business metrics.
challenge: This project simulates a real-world contact center for Energy Plus, a fictional electricity provider. The business relied on manual spreadsheets and inconsistent reporting, making it difficult for leadership to monitor operational performance, sales activity, service levels, and agent productivity.

To solve this, the objective was to design and build an interactive KPI dashboard that provides clear visibility into contact center performance, supports data-driven decision-making, and helps identify opportunities to improve efficiency, customer service, and sales outcomes.
kpiTargets: Agent Sales Target: 100+ sales per month
whatIBuilt: I wrote a SQL script to join three tables (call stats, connection stats, and agent info) into a single unified dataset. This gave Power BI one clean source to report from.

A key requirement was accurately tracking agents who moved between teams over time. I solved this using effective date logic in the SQL join, ensuring each agent's metrics were always attributed to the correct team for the correct time period — preserving historical accuracy even after team changes.
projects.dashboardDescription: The Energy Plus Contact Centre Dashboard is shown below. This Power BI solution was built from the business requirements and SQL data model presented above. Below is a summary of each dashboard page, including its purpose and the key benefits it provides to business users.

dashboardSlides.title: Summary & Glossary
description: This page serves as a reference point for stakeholders, providing essential context and definitions for the dashboard. It includes key metadata such as the report creation date, last review date, business owner, and report owner. A brief summary explains the purpose and scope of the report, helping users quickly understand what it covers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are also listed on this page, drawn directly from the project requirements, to give managers a clear understanding of the metrics being tracked. Additionally, a glossary has been included to define key terms and metrics, supporting consistent interpretation across all users.

dashboardSlides.title: Contact Centre Operations
description: This page provides senior managers and executives with a high-level view of contact centre performance throughout the year, making it easy to assess whether key monthly targets are being achieved.

The primary focus is the Connection KPI (target: 1,800 connections per month) and Service Level (target: 75%). Colour-coded KPIs provide instant insight, with green indicating targets have been met and red highlighting areas requiring attention.
bullets: Executive Summary: A single, high-level view of contact centre performance.
Instant KPI Monitoring: Colour-coded indicators quickly show whether monthly targets have been met.
Better Decision Making: Clear performance insights support operational and strategic decisions.
Trend Analysis: Track performance over time to identify trends, seasonal patterns, and potential issues early.

dashboardSlides.title: Agent Operations
description: This page is designed for team managers, providing detailed visibility into individual agent performance throughout the year. It tracks key metrics, including whether agents are achieving their monthly target of 100 connections and maintaining a conversion rate above 10%.
The dashboard helps managers recognise top performers, identify agents who need support, and deliver targeted coaching using detailed performance metrics.
bullets: Performance Tracking: Quickly identify which agents are meeting or missing their KPIs.
Targeted Coaching: Pinpoint areas where individual agents need improvement.
Recognition: Easily identify high-performing agents for reward and recognition.

dashboardSlides.title: Team Operations
dashboardSlides.description: This page gives team leaders a complete view of team performance, allowing them to quickly identify top performers, monitor overall progress, and assess whether team targets are being met—all from a single dashboard.
bullets: Team Overview: View the entire team's performance in one place.
Target Tracking: Monitor progress against team KPIs.
Performance Comparison: Compare agents to identify gaps and coaching opportunities.
Faster Decision Making: Save time with a single, consolidated view of team performance.

dashboardSlides.title: Cross-Team Performance
dashboardSlides.description: This page provides senior managers with a comparison of team performance across the contact centre. It highlights key metrics such as connections, conversion rates, and service levels, making it easy to identify top-performing teams and ensure all teams are meeting performance expectations.
bullets: Team Comparison: View all teams side by side in one dashboard.
Centre-Wide Visibility: Monitor overall contact centre performance at a glance.
Performance Monitoring: Ensure all teams are meeting key KPIs.
Better Decision Making: Use insights to guide coaching, resource allocation, and process improvements.

SELECT 
C.date,
C.offer,
C.answered,
C.agent_id,
C.total_talk,
C.total_acw,
C.total_hold,
C.asa,
C.abandon,
C.sla_met,
C.sla_over,
S.connection,
A.agent_name,
A.team,
A.effective_start_date,
A.effective_end_date
FROM call_stats C
INNER JOIN connection_stats S ON S.agent_id = C.agent_id AND C.date = S.date
INNER JOIN agent_info A ON A.agent_id = C.agent_id
AND C.date >= effective_start_date AND C.date <= A.effective_end_date -- Enables Power BI to report each agent's metrics to the correct team

projects.title: Insurance Claims Performance Dashboard
projects.dashboardDescription: The Insurance Claims Performance Dashboard is shown below. This interactive Power BI solution was developed using the SQL reporting dataset and business requirements outlined above. The following sections provide an overview of each dashboard page, highlighting its purpose and how it helps stakeholders monitor claims performance and key business KPIs.
projects.summary: This project simulates a real-world insurance claims environment for Insurix, a fictional insurance company, building an interactive KPI dashboard to monitor claim processing performance, team productivity, and operational efficiency.
challenge: This project simulates a real-world insurance claims environment for Insurix, a fictional insurance company entering a highly competitive market. Following concerns raised by the National Consumer Protection Association (NCPA) regarding claim processing times, the business needed a reliable reporting solution to monitor operational performance and ensure claims were being processed within agreed service standards.

To address this challenge, the objective was to design and build an interactive KPI dashboard that provides clear visibility into open claims, processing times, and team productivity. Using SQL for data cleaning and transformation and Power BI for interactive reporting, the solution enables stakeholders to track key performance indicators, identify processing bottlenecks, and make data-driven decisions to improve operational efficiency and customer outcomes.
whatIBuilt: Wrote a SQL script to clean, transform, and consolidate insurance claims data into a single reporting dataset, which was then used in Power BI to build the dashboard.
projects.sqlSnippet:
DECLARE @report_date DATE = '2025-01-01';

SELECT
claim_id,
account_number,
claim_status,
date, -- created date
partition_date, -- action date
owner,
claim_type,
CASE WHEN claim_status = 'A' THEN 'Approved'
     WHEN claim_status = 'O' THEN 'Open'
     WHEN claim_status = 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
     WHEN claim_status = 'D' THEN 'Declined'
END AS claim_status_true,
DATEDIFF(DAY, date, @report_date) AS claim_age,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, @report_date) < 30 THEN 'a. 1 - 29 Days'
     WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, @report_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 'b. 30 - 70 Days'
     WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, @report_date) BETWEEN 71 AND 100 THEN 'c. 71 - 100 Days'
     WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, @report_date) > 100 THEN 'd. 100 Days +'
END AS age_category,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, partition_date) < 30 THEN 'a. 1 - 29 Days'
     WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, partition_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 'b. 30 - 70 Days'
     WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, partition_date) BETWEEN 71 AND 100 THEN 'c. 71 - 100 Days'
     WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, date, partition_date) > 100 THEN 'd. 100 Days +'
END AS completed_age_category,
DATEDIFF(DAY, @report_date, DATEADD(DAY, 100, date)) AS days_until_due_date
FROM claim

dashboardSlides.title: Claims Overview
description: This page provides managers and executives with a high-level view of insurance claims performance, making it easy to monitor claim volumes, processing times, and whether key operational targets are being achieved.

The primary focus is the Over 100 Days KPI (target: fewer than 15 open claims over 100 days old), with colour-coded KPIs providing instant insight into overall claims performance and areas requiring attention.
bullets: Executive Summary: A single, high-level view of open claims, closed claims, processing times, and key operational KPIs.
KPI Monitoring: Instantly identify whether the business is meeting its target of keeping claims over 100 days below the agreed threshold.
Claims Distribution: Visualize claim volumes and age categories to better understand the current claims portfolio.
Trend Analysis: Track month-over-month claim activity and processing performance to identify trends and emerging issues early.

dashboardSlides.title: Agent Claims Performance
description: This page provides managers with a detailed view of individual agent performance, making it easy to monitor workload, track productivity, and identify claims that require immediate attention.

The primary focus is agent productivity, claim completion, and outstanding claims. Managers can quickly identify top-performing agents, monitor open workloads, and prioritize overdue claims through interactive visuals and colour-coded reporting.
bullets: Agent Performance: Compare the number of closed claims by agent and claim type to measure productivity.
Open Claims Monitoring: Identify agents with the highest number of open claims, with claims over 100 days highlighted for immediate action.
Detailed Claims Analysis: Review individual claim outcomes to better understand agent performance and workload.
Interactive Filtering: Dynamically switch between claim type and age category to analyse claims from different perspectives.

dashboardSlides.title: Open Claims Management
description: This page provides managers and claims teams with a dedicated view of all open claims, making it easy to monitor workloads, prioritize overdue cases, and ensure claims are progressing within service targets.
The primary focus is open claim management, allowing users to quickly identify aging claims, track upcoming due dates, and monitor workloads across the team to support timely claim resolution.
bullets: Open Claims Overview: View all open claims by age category to understand workload distribution at a glance.
Priority Monitoring: Quickly identify overdue and high-risk claims so they can be actioned before service targets are missed.
Workload Management: Track assigned claims and due dates to help balance workloads across the team.
Improved Visibility: Provides a centralized view of outstanding claims, helping managers prioritize work and improve processing efficiency.

dashboardSlides.title: Closed Claims Performance
description: This page provides managers and executives with a detailed view of closed claims, making it easy to monitor claim completion trends, measure productivity, and evaluate how efficiently claims are being resolved.
The primary focus is claim closure performance, allowing users to compare monthly results, identify changes in productivity, and understand how quickly different claim types are being processed.
bullets: Performance Monitoring: Track the number of claims closed each month to measure operational performance over time.
Month-on-Month Analysis: Compare current results against the previous month to quickly identify improvements or declines in claim closures.
Claims Resolution Insights: Analyze closed claims by claim type and age category to understand processing efficiency.

dashboardSlides.title: Page 5 — Raw Data
description: This page was created to give stakeholders direct access to the underlying data, without the visualizations or formatting used in other pages.
bullets: Full Data Table: Displays all claim records in a simple, unfiltered table for easy exploration.
Download / Export Option: Allows stakeholders to extract the data for further analysis outside of Power BI.
